facts.fact: The Government's OGP National Action Plan lists, among Digital Governance achievements of the 2023-2025 plan period, "Adoption and operationalization of the National Digitalization Policy, (2023-2028)"; it names no adopting act or body, and the date is the document's own published date (2025-06) as no event date is given.
